shots.title: Research with a wallet
shots.label: XRPL Testnet
shots.vo: ResearchAgent gives coding agents a research wallet. Ask a question and set a budget. Paid on delivery. Proven on the ledger.

shots.title: Question, paywall, payment
shots.label: Hosted recording · policy rules decide purchases · two team-authored paid writers; free Open Records
shots.vo: How does the writer get paid, and what stops the agent from reading the article and then refusing to pay? Free sources first. Policy buys the missing passage within your budget. This run bought one S$0.40 article. The key that unlocks the article is the same key that releases the writer's payment.

shots.title: Check the key
shots.label: Local replay · recorded escrow · fictional writer
shots.vo: The writer collects by publishing the article key. This browser reads both transactions from a public node and hashes the key. It matches the payment lock.

shots.title: Verify the recorded proof
shots.label: Hosted recording · featured run 421bae3d · 12 Nov · 5/5 gates Held
shots.vo: Check the recorded proof without asking a question. The featured run shows all five gates held: twenty-four checks passed and two not checked.

shots.title: Check outside the app
shots.label: Published Python verifier · recorded receipts · read-only checks
shots.vo: Export the receipts and check them outside the app. Our TypeScript and Python verifiers were written separately. The receipts tie the cited passages to the payment.

shots.title: Writer identity
shots.label: Recorded hosted writer view
shots.vo: The writer view links accepted operator-issued Credentials to the writer wallet. Follow the identity record and the payment directly from the app.

shots.title: Policy authority
shots.label: Policy rules decide purchases
shots.vo: Only policy code can pay. The language model cannot raise the budget. The five-second plan sheet confirms how the research will proceed.

shots.title: The same tools in Claude Code
shots.label: Recorded Claude Code + MCP result
shots.vo: Claude Code uses the same research tools over MCP. The spending caps come from the environment; the calling model can't raise them. The result includes cited passages and payment links.

shots.title: The key matches
shots.label: Check the key
shots.vo: From a question to a paid passage, in the browser or Claude Code. Paid on delivery. Proven on the ledger. Check it yourself. The key matches the payment lock.

endCard.limits: Development network only; mainnet signing disabled. No independent writers, customers, pilots or revenue; demand unvalidated. Signed submission can expose the key before validation; escrow remains claimable until CancelAfter. Key reveal proves delivery, not quality. Quality refunds need writer cooperation; a real writer could refuse. No-show recovery requires validated EscrowCancel. Operator identity is not KYC or payment permission. Shared payer and visitor caps; cold installs depend on npm and faucet latency. Registry publication, Mac signing, custody, screening, KYB and licensing remain.
